Release Notes

Current version: v2.4.1 Latest: June 3, 2025
5 Releases
23 Features added
41 Bugs fixed
Jun '25 Last updated

v2.4.1

June 3, 2025 Patch Latest

Hotfix for GPS drift on Android 14 devices and stop clustering improvements for dense urban routes.

FIX Resolved a GPS drift issue on Android 14 where driver positions would appear to jump 200–400 meters during high-speed transit on certain Pixel and Samsung devices.
FIX Fixed an edge case where routes containing stops with identical addresses (e.g., two deliveries to the same building) would silently deduplicate and drop one stop during optimization.
IMP Improved stop clustering algorithm for dense urban routes — groupings are now 18% tighter on average for cities with grid layouts, reducing total miles driven per route.
IMP Route recalculation after a failed delivery is now 2–3x faster for routes with more than 50 remaining stops.
FIX Dashboard map no longer briefly flickers to a default zoom level when a driver completes a stop and the map view updates.

v2.4.0

April 17, 2025 Feature

Introduces multi-driver route splitting, customer SMS notifications, and a redesigned stop detail panel on mobile.

NEW Multi-driver splitting: Upload a single list of stops and let PocketRoute automatically divide them across 2–10 drivers, balancing load by stop count, estimated drive time, or geographic zone. Available on Growth and Team plans.
NEW Customer SMS notifications: Automatically send delivery ETA and confirmation texts to recipients. Configure templates and opt-out language under Settings → Customer Notifications. Requires a verified sender phone number.
NEW Redesigned stop detail panel (mobile): The stop sheet now shows recipient contact info, delivery notes, photo proof attachment, and a one-tap call button without scrolling.
NEW Proof of delivery photos: Drivers can attach up to 3 photos per stop (package at door, signature capture, or custom). Photos sync to the dispatcher dashboard in real time.
IMP CSV import now supports an optional phone column for recipient contact numbers, used for SMS notifications.
FIX Fixed time window constraints being ignored when re-optimizing a partially completed route (stops already delivered were incorrectly included in the re-optimization window check).
FIX Resolved an issue where the driver app showed a blank map on first launch if the device had never used a mapping app before (no cached map tiles).

v2.3.5

March 5, 2025 Bug Fix

Stability and performance patch addressing crashes on large routes and address geocoding accuracy improvements.

FIX Fixed a memory management bug causing the iOS app to crash when loading routes with more than 150 stops. Root cause was an unbounded cache in the map tile renderer.
FIX Addressed geocoding failures for addresses in Puerto Rico and US territories — these were being routed through the wrong regional geocoder.
IMP Optimization engine now handles routes up to 250 stops (previously capped at 200) without performance degradation.
FIX Route export to PDF was truncating stops beyond position 99 in the numbered list. Now supports up to 250 stops in exported documents.
FIX Dashboard correctly shows "Route In Progress" status rather than "Assigned" when a driver has started a route but hasn't confirmed the first stop yet.

v2.3.0

January 28, 2025 Feature

Introduces the Reporting Center, recurring routes, and full API v1 GA availability.

NEW Reporting Center: Track delivery success rates, average time per stop, miles driven, and driver performance metrics across custom date ranges. Export to CSV or PDF.
NEW Recurring routes: Save a route as a template and schedule it to repeat daily, weekly, or on custom days. Dispatched automatically at a configured time. Available on Growth and Team plans.
NEW API v1 is now generally available (previously in beta). Full stability guarantees, SLA, and versioned endpoints. See the API reference.
NEW Webhook events: Subscribe to route.dispatched, stop.completed, stop.failed, and route.completed events for real-time integration with your own systems.
DEP API v0 (beta) endpoints under /beta/ are deprecated and will be removed on August 1, 2025. Migrate to /v1/ endpoints before that date.

v2.2.0

November 12, 2024 Major

Complete redesign of the dispatcher dashboard, live map performance overhaul, and real-time traffic integration.

NEW Redesigned dispatcher dashboard: The route list, live map, and driver status panel are now side-by-side in a single view. No more switching between tabs to track progress.
NEW Real-time traffic routing: Routes now incorporate live traffic data from HERE Maps when traffic-aware mode is enabled. Drivers receive re-routing suggestions mid-route when significant delays are detected.
IMP Live map rendering is now 60% faster with 40+ drivers active simultaneously, achieved through clustering and level-of-detail rendering at different zoom levels.
NEW Driver messaging: Dispatchers can send text messages to individual drivers or broadcast to all active drivers directly from the dashboard. Drivers receive messages as in-app notifications.
NEW Delivery confirmation codes: Optional 4-digit codes recipients can provide to drivers to confirm receipt. Useful for high-value deliveries requiring identity verification.
DEP The legacy "Classic" dashboard view (the original 2021 interface) has been permanently removed. All users are now on the new dashboard.
